hold_line.description: Nobody moves. Worth more the more wall is already standing on your stretch.

call_others.description: You shout, and the ones who know you by name answer.

show_watch.description: The torch runs along the top of the wall. Worth a great deal if there were people on watch last night; next to nothing if there weren't.

half_and_half.description: Nobody puts down the trowel to pick up the spear. Everyone does both at once, and that is the part they weren't expecting.

keep_working.description: You said no once already and you are not going down now. There is no answer to give: the work carries on, and they go on waiting.

keep_counting.description: You lay stone counting the courses out loud, so as not to count what they are saying. The work is the only answer they get to hear.

keep_building.description: Stone on stone. The wall goes up, and nobody eats a wall.

give_back.description: Field, vineyard, house and the interest charged on top. It costs part of your day, and it is the one thing that answers what they are shouting.

refuse_ration.description: The ration the work owes you stays on somebody else's table today. It costs part of your day, and it is what can be seen from far off.
